text:
maya: Short idea for next webinar: run a "credit ladder" experiment. Instead of one bulk credit grant, users earn small credits as they complete micro-steps (join, run starter prompt, finish 1-min lab, share result). Hypothesis: staged rewards => higher immediate engagement and prompt reuse. Thoughts? :sparkles:

luis: Love it. Two Qs: what's control, and how do we include folks who sign up after the live session?

maya: Control = normal 100 credits after webinar. Ladder = 4 steps (15, 25, 40, 20). Use CTA shortlink with ?flow=ladderQ2 so post-signups get same timed drips.

tara: Suggest cap experiment at first 1k signups. Also add in-webinar micro lab (2 clicks) to reduce friction. I'll draft two CTA lines: action-focused and curiosity-focused.

devon: For metrics we need events: ladder_join, starter_run, lab_completed, share_submitted, credits_awarded. Add property flow_variant. I'll add to event schema ticket.

sam: I'll create shortlink rdw.in/ladderQ2 and set UTM: utm_campaign=ladder_q2. Also will upload seed list to growth bucket.

tracking-bot: Reminder: include token_cost_estimate on template pages so users know expected spend (suggest 100-200 tokens/run).

maya: Quick ops pseudocode for routing: if params.flow == "ladderQ2": tag user.flow = "ladderQ2"; schedule email t+30m deliver step1; show in-app prompt after token creation.

luis: Success criteria: +15% 24h activation vs control, +20% template reuse in 72h, support contacts <10% of cohort. If positive, roll to next webinar.

tara: Will post CTA copy and slide snippet by EOD. Sync tomorrow 10am to verify instrumentation and PRs. :thumbsup:
